js: (async () => { const s = await window.api.settings.get(); await window.api.settings.set({ llmProvider: 'custom', customBaseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:18777/v1', llmModels: { ...s.llmModels, custom: 'mock-model' } }); const s2 = await window.api.settings.get(); window.__prog = []; window.api.on.scriptProgress((e) => { window.__prog.push(e.from + '-' + e.to + '/' + e.total + ' b' + e.chunk + '/' + e.chunks); console.log('PROGRES adegan ' + e.from + '-' + e.to + ' dari ' + e.total + ' (bagian ' + e.chunk + '/' + e.chunks + ')'); }); console.log('MOCK-SETUP ok provider=' + s2.llmProvider + ' base=' + s2.customBaseUrl + ' model=' + s2.llmModels.custom); })()

(async () => { const b = await window.api.projects.create({ synopsis: 'Uji naskah per bagian: kisah kucing yang hilang di pasar.', durationSec: 90 }); window.__p90 = b.project.id; window.__prog = []; const out = await window.api.story.script(window.__p90); console.log('UJI-A 90dtk adegan=' + out.clips.length + ' (mau 16) progres=' + JSON.stringify(window.__prog)); })()

(async () => { const b = await window.api.projects.create({ synopsis: 'Uji preset 30 detik.', durationSec: 30 }); window.__p30 = b.project.id; window.__prog = []; const out = await window.api.story.script(window.__p30); console.log('UJI-E preset30 adegan=' + out.clips.length + ' (mau 5) progres=' + JSON.stringify(window.__prog)); })()

(async () => { const b = await window.api.projects.create({ synopsis: 'Uji naskah 20 menit, gagal di bagian 3.', durationSec: 1200 }); window.__p1200 = b.project.id; window.__prog = []; try { await window.api.story.script(window.__p1200); console.log('UJI-BC TIDAK GAGAL (tidak diharapkan)'); } catch (e) { console.log('UJI-BC gagal seperti diharapkan: ' + e.message); } const after = await window.api.projects.get(window.__p1200); console.log('UJI-BC tersimpan=' + after.clips.length + ' (mau 60) progres=' + JSON.stringify(window.__prog)); })()

(async () => { const before = await window.api.projects.get(window.__p1200); window.__first60 = before.clips.slice(0, 60).map((c) => c.title + '|' + c.narration).join('\n'); window.__prog = []; const out = await window.api.story.continueScript(window.__p1200); const after60 = out.clips.slice(0, 60).map((c) => c.title + '|' + c.narration).join('\n'); console.log('UJI-C lanjut adegan=' + out.clips.length + ' (mau 218) 60-pertama-sama=' + (window.__first60 === after60) + ' progres=' + JSON.stringify(window.__prog)); })()

(async () => { const b = await window.api.projects.get(window.__p90); window.__d15 = b.clips.slice(0, 15).map((c) => c.title + '|' + c.narration).join('\n'); const clips = b.clips.map((c) => ({ ...c })); clips[15] = { ...clips[15], narration: 'tiga kata saja' }; await window.api.projects.save({ project: b.project, characters: b.characters, clips }); console.log('UJI-D adegan-16 dirusak narasi=tiga kata saja'); window.__prog = []; const out = await window.api.story.continueScript(window.__p90); const after15 = out.clips.slice(0, 15).map((c) => c.title + '|' + c.narration).join('\n'); console.log('UJI-D lanjut adegan=' + out.clips.length + ' (mau 16) 15-pertama-sama=' + (window.__d15 === after15) + ' adegan16-baru=' + out.clips[15].title + ' | ' + out.clips[15].narration + ' progres=' + JSON.stringify(window.__prog)); })()

(async () => { const b = await window.api.projects.create({ synopsis: 'Uji lanjutkan dari nol adegan.', durationSec: 60 }); window.__prog = []; const out = await window.api.story.continueScript(b.project.id); console.log('UJI-0 lanjutkan-dari-nol adegan=' + out.clips.length + ' (mau 11) progres=' + JSON.stringify(window.__prog)); })()

(async () => { const b = await window.api.projects.create({ synopsis: 'Uji 429 berhenti tanpa retry.', durationSec: 60 }); window.__prog = []; try { await window.api.story.script(b.project.id); console.log('UJI-R TIDAK GAGAL (tidak diharapkan)'); } catch (e) { console.log('UJI-R gagal seperti diharapkan: ' + e.message); } const after = await window.api.projects.get(b.project.id); console.log('UJI-R tersimpan=' + after.clips.length + ' (mau 0: 429 langsung berhenti, tanpa retry) progres=' + JSON.stringify(window.__prog)); })()
